The fungi exhibit a coral-like branching structure with multiple upright stems dividing into finer, bead-like or granular tips. The background consists of brown leaves, twigs, and mossy wood.

The background elements (wood grain and leaves) show slight smearing and lack of crisp edge definition where they meet the fungus. The wood grain pattern is somewhat inconsistent and blurry, suggesting minor generative artifacts in the non-subject areas.
